examples.purpose: A protection score on the Money screen, the guide's In context: under the page's Title, the card shows the score Active at 72 with its reading and two-line nudge; View details runs the screen's own action through onPressButton.
examples.jsx:
<VStack>
  <Title title="Your money" subtitle="October 2026" />
  <CardFinancialCondition
    title="Protection"
    body="Check your coverage and gaps"
    progressState="Active"
    value={72}
    nudgeBody={'There may be gaps in your health or life cover\nAdd coverage to stay financially secure'}
    buttonLabel="View details"
    onPressButton={() => {}}
  />
</VStack>

from.quote: View details runs the screen’s own action through onPressButton.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Without it, the card is named by title, score and body (“Protection, 72 out of 100. Check your coverage and gaps”, or valueLabel in place of the score) while the ring is Active; while it is Inactive (or progressState false) the name leaves out the score (“Protection. Check your coverage and gaps”), and the ring itself reads “Inactive progress”. Declared: Accessibility label for the whole card.

props.name: title
props.description: Title text shown in the header. Default "Protection", from the component source.

props.name: body
props.description: Body / description shown below the title. Default "Check your coverage and gaps", from the component source.

props.name: value
props.description: The score out of 100; the ring clamps it to 0–100. Declared: Progress score for the circular indicator. Forwarded to CircularProgressBar. Default 0, from the component source.

props.name: progressState
props.description: Visual state of the circular indicator. Forwarded to CircularProgressBar. Default "Inactive", from the component source.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Replaces the number in the ring. Declared: Optional formatted value label for the active state.

props.name: showNudge
props.description: Also gates nudgeSlot: with showNudge false, a nudgeSlot doesn't render either. Declared: Show the bottom advisory nudge. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: nudgeBody
props.default:
There may be gaps in your health or life cover
Add coverage to stay financially secure
props.description: Body text for the default nudge. Use `\n` to add a second line. Default "There may be gaps in your health or life cover\nAdd coverage to stay financially secure", from the component source.

props.name: showDivider
props.description: Show the bottom divider above the action button. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: showButton
props.description: Also gates buttonSlot: with showButton false, a buttonSlot doesn't render either. Declared: Show the action button at the bottom of the card. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: buttonLabel
props.description: Label for the default action button. Default "View Details", from the component source.

props.name: onPressButton
props.description: Runs when the button is pressed; the card itself is not pressable. The button has no disabled or loading state, and the card's nudge has no title, button or close. Declared: Callback for the default action button press.

props.name: progressSlot
props.description: Slot replacing the default circular progress bar. Receives `modes` recursively.

props.name: nudgeSlot
props.description: Slot replacing the default Nudge. Receives `modes` recursively.

props.name: buttonSlot
props.description: Its components get the button's modes (AppearanceBrand Secondary, Context CTACard over the card's); progressSlot and nudgeSlot get the card's modes. Declared: Slot replacing the default action button. Receives `modes` recursively.

props.name: modes
props.description: Design token modes forwarded to token lookups and child components.

props.name: style
props.description: Container style override.

props.name: headerStyle
props.description: Header row style override.

props.name: titleStyle
props.description: Title text style override.

props.name: bodyStyle
props.description: Body text style override.

props.name: ...CardFinancialConditionBaseProps

modes.name: AppearanceBrand
modes.description: The card sets AppearanceBrand Neutral itself, over the collection's Primary default; the theme's modes and the card's own modes are merged on top of it. Declared: A token collection CardFinancialCondition reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: AppearanceSystem
modes.description: Only with Semantic Intent System: positive green, warning orange, negative red on the ring, the nudge and the button. AppearanceSystem alone does nothing. Declared: A token collection CardFinancialCondition reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.
